source_note: Official PARSEC track archives published by the Padova group under https://stev.oapd.inaf.it/PARSEC/Database/ (plain static downloads, verified live 2026-10-11). The upstream publishes no checksums; sha256 is computed at download time and recorded in each MANIFEST. The host's TLS chain omits its intermediate CA (ZeroSSL RSA DV SSL CA 2); the bundled intermediate completes the chain so verification stays on. PARSEC publishes NO isochrone packages: the CMD web form computes isochrone tables server-side on request and cannot be scripted (header-only results, verified 2026-10-11); it is not an acquisition channel — build isochrones locally from these tracks with stellariso.synthesis instead.
scope_note: Track products: PARSEC v1.2S (the CMD interface's default track set, read and synthesized by stellariso), and the PARSEC v2.0 lines (rotating, very-massive-star, pure-helium) which are downloaded as data; v2.0 track readers are not implemented yet (different 95-column format). Historical pre-2006 tracks on pleiadi.oapd.inaf.it are out of scope.

format_notes.tracks_v12s: PARSEC v1.2S track zip: one plain-text file per initial mass named like Z0.0001Y0.249OUTA1.74_F7_M001.200.DAT (M{initial mass:7.3f}), one uncommented header line of 24 column names, then fixed-width data rows: MODELL MASS AGE LOG_L LOG_TE LOG_R LOG_RAT M_CORE_HE M_CORE_C H_CEN HE_CEN C_cen O_cen LX LY LC LNEUTR L_GRAV H_SUP HE_SUP C_SUP N_SUP O_SUP PHASE. AGE is in years; LOG_R is log10 radius in cm (solar radius = 10^10.844 cm); there is no log_g column. *.HB.DAT files are horizontal-branch tracks with the same header; the single *ADD.DAT file per zip is to be discarded (readme instruction).
format_notes.tracks_v20: PARSEC v2.0 rotating tracks: 95-column format without a PHASE column; very-low-mass entries (M <~ 0.7 Msun) keep the old 22-column v1.2S subset. Not yet read by stellariso.
